gbm_population_evidence.quote: now has radiographic progression consistent with a grade 4 GBM (IDH wild type), grade 4 diffuse astrocytoma (IDH mutant), or has a unifocal relapse of GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase 1b study to evaluate the safety of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells with a chlorotoxin tumor-targeting domain (ie, CHM-1101, the study treatment)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapsed disease: radiographic evidence of recurrence/progression of measurable disease after standard therapy and ≥ 12 weeks after completion of front-line radiation therapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous chlorotoxin-directed CAR T-cell therapy (CHM-1101), intracavitary/intraventricular delivery

source_quote.quote: Confirmed MMP2+ tumor expression by IHC (≥20% moderate/high MMP2 score \[2+ or 3+\]).

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR T-cell therapy (excluded type), so no candidate. MMP2 eligibility is mechanistically linked to the chlorotoxin CAR-T but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Population includes grade 4 IDH-mutant astrocytoma alongside IDH-wildtype GBM, hence mixed. IDH is mentioned (wild type or mutant both allowed) and is not an entry requirement, so not listed as a biomarker. CAR T levels in TCF/CSF are measured but concern the excluded-type agent, not a candidate.
